name: Integrated Biomedical Sciences (IBS) PhD
detailsNote: The program page lists "01/01/2027 Application opens in August for the next Fall term admission" under Application Deadlines, which does not clearly state a deadline, so it is shown as a published date. The Graduate School's latest Fall 2027 dates are also shown; programs may have earlier deadlines.
summary: Integrated Biomedical Sciences PhD at the University of Kentucky. Students are admitted to IBS, do lab rotations, and choose a doctoral program and mentor at the end of the first year.

english.toefl: 79 (internet-based, for exams before January 21, 2026); 4.0 for exams after January 21, 2026
english.note: The Graduate School also lists a TOEFL Essentials minimum of 9 on the program page. All applicants must show proof of English proficiency.

applicationFee.note: The Graduate School fee is $65 domestic and $75 international. Its page offers waivers only for US military veterans and for military spouses or dependents with eligibility documents, so international applicants should confirm.

documents: Personal statement on research interests and goals
Names and contact information of three faculty members as recommenders
requirements.note: The program page does not mention the GRE; the Graduate School says it depends on the program.

funding.note: The page says students are typically awarded full-tuition assistance, student health insurance and a yearly stipend. No stipend amount, year or international coverage is stated.
